nuggets.text: Mason Heintschel threw seven touchdown passes in the opener, tying Pete Gonzalez's 1997 school record.
All seven of Mason Heintschel's touchdown passes in the opener went to different receivers.
Pat Narduzzi played for his own father, Bill, as a Youngstown State freshman in 1985.
The Panthers are credited with the first known use of jersey numbers in football, back in 1908.
A 1921 Panthers win was the first college football game broadcast live on US radio.
Acrisure Stadium, home to Pitt and the Steelers, was built with 12,000 tons of steel.
The Panthers claim nine national titles, the last in 1976, when Tony Dorsett won the Heisman.
The Panthers' last meeting with UCF, in 2019, was a 35-34 win over the No. 15 Knights.
The Panthers rank first in the FBS in passing after one week at 480 yards per game.
Pat Narduzzi is second on Pitt's all-time wins list, behind only Hall of Famer Jock Sutherland.
